_meanings:
.²1 To go, move, walk, proceed; {#yayO tadIyAmavalambya cANgulim#} <ls>R. 3. 25</ls>;
 {#anvagyayO maDyamalokapAlaH#} <ls n="R.">2. 16</ls>.
.²2 To march against, invade; {#tadA yAyAd vigfhyEva vyasane cotTite ripoH#} <ls>Ms. 7. 183</ls>.
.²3 To go to, march towards, set out for (with <ab>acc.</ab>, <ab>dat.</ab> or with {#prati#}).
.²4 To pass away, withdraw, depart; {#yAtu prastutamanusaMDIyatAm#} <ls>H. 3</ls>
 ‘let it go or pass, never mind it’
.²5 To vanish, disappear; {#yAtastavApi ca vivekaH#} <ls>Bv. 1. 66</ls>; {#BAgyakrameRa#}
 {#hi DanAni Bavanti yAnti#} <ls>Mk. 1. 13</ls>.
.²6 To pass away or by, elapse (as time); {#yOvanamanivarti yArtaM tu#} <ls>K. P. 10</ls>.
.²7 To last.
.²8 To happen, come to pass.
.²9 To go or be reduced to any state, be or become (usually with the <ab>acc.</ab>
 of abstract noun).

.²10 To undertake; {#na tvasya sidDO yAsyAmi sargavyApAramAtmanA#} <ls>Ku. 2. 54</ls>.
.²11 To have carnal intercourse with.
.²12 To request, implore.
.²13 To find out, discover.
.²14 To behave, act. (The meanings of {#yA#}, like those of {#gam#}, are
 variously modified according to the noun with which it is connected; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%}
 {#nISaM yA#} to be destroyed; {#vAcyatAM yA#} to incur blame or censure;
 {#laGutAM yA#} to be slighted; {#prakftiM yA#} to regain oneʼs natural
 state; {#nidrAM yA#} to fall asleep; {#vaSaM yA#} to submit, go into oneʼs
 possession; {#udayaM yA#} to rise; {#astaM yA#} to set, decline; {#pAraM#}
 {#yA#} to reach the other side of, to master, surmount, get over; {#padaM#}
 {#yA#} to attain to the position of; {#agre yA#} to go before, take the
 lead, lead; {#aDo yA#} to sink; {#viparyAsaM yA#} to undergo a change,
 to be changed in appearance; {#SirasA mahIM yA#} to bend the head down
 to the ground <ab>&c.</ab>).

.²1 To cause to go or proceed.
.²2 To remove, drive away; {#pramadayA madayApitalajjayA#} <ls>R. 9. 31</ls>.
.²3 To spend, pass (time); {#tAvat kokila virasAn yApaya divasAn#} <ls>Bv. 1. 7</ls>; <ls>Me. 91</ls>.
.²4 To live or spend time with; {#vinayAdiva yApayanti te DftarAzwrAtmajamAtmasidDaye#} <ls>Ki. 2. 45</ls>.
.²5 To support, nourish.
.²6 To give sendoff; {#snehapraklinnahfdayo yApayAmAsa koSalaH#} <ls>Bhāg. 10. 58. 52</ls>.

To wish to go, to be about
 to go <ab>&c.</ab>

.²2 to surpass. {#aDi#} to go away or forth; escape; {#kuto 'DiyAsyasi#}
 {#krUra nihatastena patriBiH#} <ls>Bk. 8. 90</ls>.
